brief.about: The landing page for an app that connects people with farmers in their area.
brief.notes: Primary goal: join the waitlist (app not launched yet). One main call to action across the page: Join the waitlist. Replace all Relay support-software sample content; do not invent farmers, quotes, numbers or prices.

brand.name: Boulder Foodshed
brand.voice: A neighbour at a farm-stand: warm, plain-spoken, a little proud of the place. Short sentences. No tech jargon.

leaf.usage: Tiny details only, used through components

squash.usage: Secondary highlight for stickers and small badges, used through components

rules: Direction: Farm Stand at 8am. Paper-bag cream grounds every page; text is soil brown, never pure black.
Tomato red is for the Join the waitlist button, links and small hand-drawn accents. Squash yellow is the only secondary highlight. Leaf green appears only in tiny details.
Headlines in Fraunces: huge, heavy, sentence case, tightly set. At most one word per headline gets a hand-drawn underline or circle.
Body text in DM Sans, plain and friendly. Write like a neighbour at a market stall, not a software company.
One main action per screen: Join the waitlist. Everything else is quieter.
Photos are real, close-up and warm: hands, soil, produce, farms. No stock smiles, no laptops or phone mockups as the hero. Until real photos arrive, leave clearly marked gaps.
Shapes are rounded and a little imperfect, like stickers and painted signs. Dark sections use deep soil brown, not black.
Alternate cream, kraft, tomato and soil sections for rhythm, never more than three of the same in a row.
Never invent farmers, quotes, numbers, dates or prices. Mark gaps instead.

notes: Your brand colour #c4402a leads the palette (buttons, links and accents).
Dark sections use your #3b2a1f as the ground with #f6edde text.
Your fonts (Fraunces, DM Sans) are used as they are — free on Google Fonts and published with the site.
Text sizes kept: display 96px, h1 64px, h2 46px, h3 32px, h4 24px, lead 22px.
Corners: round, as in your tokens.
7 colour pairings were nudged so all text stays readable (WCAG AA), e.g. success #007835 → #007333.
